findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: deals_listCampaigns · Private data: funds_listFunds · Public sink: public-procurement_listCompetitionIndices, public-procurement_listConcentrationIndices, public-procurement_listDirectProcurementIndices, public-procurement_listLocalizationIndices.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: deals_listCampaigns · Private data: funds_listFunds · Public sink: public-procurement_listCompetitionIndices, public-procurement_listConcentrationIndices, public-procurement_listDirectProcurementIndices, public-procurement_listLocalizationIndices

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
